newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent extends losses in late trading.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent extends losses in late trading.

text.p: August Brent futures extended losses in late trading on Wednesday after weak API data and as Iraq oil sales edged closer to reality, brokers said on SIMEX on Wednesday.
August Brent was last traded at $18.08, for a loss of 30 cents compared with London's close.
NYMEX August was also down, last trading at $19.42, off 31 cents from New York.
API data showed a smaller draw in gasoline stocks than had been expected and implied demand weakened a bit.

In addition, Iraq has given the United Nations a draft of its food plan for the second tranche of oil money. Further discussions were needed to iron out some areas, Iraq's U.N. coordinator Staffan de Mistura said.
